strings.name: Angélique Kidjo
strings.summary: Raised in a musical and theatrical family in Benin, Kidjo moved to Paris in 1983, studied jazz and built collaborations across West Africa, Europe and the Americas. Her multilingual singing connects traditional rhythms, jazz and pop arrangements, with Grammy-winning albums. She serves as a UNICEF ambassador and supports girls’ development. Her collaborative album HOPE!! appeared in 2026.
